text:
owen: deploy-bot triggered promotion: payments-service chart bump 2.9.1 -> 3.4.0 (payments-core subchart 1.7.0 -> 1.8.0) to eu-west & us-central. change window open until 22:00 UTC. watching metrics

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for payments-service/payments-core in eu-west (pods: payments-core-canary-1). status: in-progress. health checks passing initially.

kai: seeing a ~38% 5xx spike on dedicated-gpu-pool-eu-west about 3m after canary started. stack traces point to serde/deserializer errors.

jen: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123/payments?var-region=eu-west — errors & latency jump correlated. @mike can you grab logs?

mike: grabbing logs from canary pod. snippet: ```ERROR serde.DeserializationException: unknown field 'legacy_flag' at line 1``` looks like a schema/contract change in payments-core 1.8.0. older callers failing.

sara: is this only on Dedicated or are Hosted customers impacted? need quick decision: rollback vs patch.

infra-oncall: infra-oncall: confirmed error spike confined to dedicated eu-west pools. hosted endpoints show normal error rate. no infra-level resource exhaustion.

owen: deploy-bot can we pause further promotions? also prefer to pin eu-west back to previous chart until we validate.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pausing promotion to us-central. initiating rollback in eu-west. Applying chart pin -> rolling back payments-core to 1.7.0. Command executed: `helm rollback payments-service --namespace prod --kube-context eu-west --to-revision 5`

kai: rollback in progress, watching pods come up.

jen: note for release notes: revert chart bump for payments-core. prepping a short blurb and adding monitor links.

mike: after rollback, recommend running smoke E2E with header `X-Canary: rollback-test` and verifying deserialization test vectors.

owen: capturing artifact id that failed: sha256:abcdef1234567890... will attach to ticket. log this as a rollback decision, not a full outage.

jen: draft changelog line: "Reverted payments-core 1.8.0 due to deserialization regression causing elevated 5xx on dedicated workloads; rolled back to 1.7.0." will push to release-notes repo and tag for approval.

infra-oncall: eu-west error-rate back to baseline ~4m after rollback. all health checks passing.

sara: thanks all. next steps: product + eng to decide whether to ship a hotfix for 1.8.0 (fixing missing legacy_flag tolerant parsing) or rework compatibility. I'll schedule a review tomorrow and block further promotions for payments-service until signoff. :thumbsup:

owen: closing loop — manual pin applied and promotions paused. filing short RCA in #postmortems for tracking. anyone else?

mike: ACK, will run the smoke tests and post results in this thread.

jen: I posted the draft release note and linked the rollback command + grafana in the ticket.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promotion paused for payments-service. no further promotions will be applied until the flag `promo-unblock: true` is set by a release lead.

owen: thanks team — resolving thread.
